report: Address 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555 was examined, but the evidence is borderline. IDENTICAL_TX_PATTERN: the address follows the identical transaction sequence of 9 sibling addresses — the same three amounts, in the same order, against the same single contract, repeated without deviation. BURST_ACTIVITY: the address executed 22 transactions inside one 45-minute window, then stopped entirely. Funding: the first funds arrived from 0x9aFunder77aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff66778899aa, whereas the 9 sibling addresses were first funded from 0x9aFunder77aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff66778899ab. The two addresses match in every character except one character in the middle. The report flags this as possibly a copy error, and explicitly does not conclude that the funder is the same. Nothing is stated about the age of the address history, about counterparties, or about any verified identity.
title: Behaviour evidence report — borderline cluster candidate B
